sentences.zh: Whoop 还为我提供可操作的个性化见解，让我变得更有主见，这意味着我在日常生活中能做出更明智的决定，

sentences.en: New listeners, old listeners, wherever you are in the world, it is so great to have you here back for another episode as we, of course, break down the psychology of our 20s.
sentences.zh: 无论你是新听众还是老听众，无论你身处世界的哪一个角落，非常高兴你能回来收听新的一期节目，当然，我们要在这里剖析二十岁的人生心理学。

sentences.en: I hope you all had a transformative, fun, but safe start to the new year.
sentences.zh: 我希望大家的新年开局都有意义、充满乐趣且安全无虞。

sentences.en: Welcome to 2025.
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到 2025 年。

sentences.en: Before we get into this episode, a few months back, I said that I had a lot of surprises in store for this year.
sentences.zh: 在进入本期节目之前，几个月前我说过今年我准备了许多惊喜。

sentences.en: And guess what?
sentences.zh: 你猜怎么着？

sentences.en: You did not have to wait long for the first one and probably one of the biggest ones.
sentences.zh: 你根本不用等太久就能迎来第一个惊喜，而且很可能是最大惊喜之一。

sentences.en: I am so beyond excited to announce that my brand new podcast, Mantra, will be launching on the 13th of January.
sentences.zh: 我无比兴奋地向大家宣布，我的全新播客《Mantra》将于 1 月 13 日正式上线。

sentences.en: Yes, you heard me right.
sentences.zh: 是的，你没听错。

sentences.en: A brand new podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 一个全新的播客。

sentences.en: And if you are a fan of the psychology of your 20s, you're going to love this.
sentences.zh: 如果你喜欢《二十岁的人生心理学》，那你一定会爱上这个新节目。

sentences.en: If you're interested in expanding your mind, improving your mindset, growing as a person, learning,
sentences.zh: 如果你对拓展思维、改善心态、个人成长和学习感兴趣，

sentences.en: Mantra is going to be the perfect fit for you.
sentences.zh: 《Mantra》将是你的不二之选。

sentences.en: Every Monday, I focus on a new mantra mantra so you can begin your week with a mental reset.
sentences.zh: 每周一，我都会聚焦一个全新的咒语（Mantra），让你以心灵的重置开启新的一周。

sentences.en: And I talk to you about the meaning of the mantra, how to really take advantage of what that mantra can do for you, where we can see it show up in our lives
sentences.zh: 我会和你探讨这个咒语的含义，如何真正发挥它对你的积极作用，我们在生活中哪里能看到它的身影，

sentences.en: and also journal prompts, a weekly challenge.
sentences.zh: 还有手帐提示和每周挑战。

sentences.en: And we have been working so hard on this.
sentences.zh: 为了这个节目我们付出了巨大的努力。

sentences.en: And the reason I really wanted to do a show like this is because I love the psychology of your 20s.
sentences.zh: 我之所以非常想做这样一档节目，是因为我热爱《二十岁的人生心理学》。

sentences.en: It is, of course, my creative baby.
sentences.zh: 这当然是我的创意结晶。

sentences.en: But I also wanted to have a space that isn't just the science, it's more inspirational and reaffirming, perhaps even more spiritual, which is also an important part of who I am,
sentences.zh: 但我也希望有一个空间，不仅仅局限于科学，还能带来更多的启迪和肯定，甚至带有一点精神层面的色彩，这也是我性格中重要的一部分，

sentences.en: along with my love of humans and numbers and studies and the psychology of things.
sentences.zh: 伴随着我对人类、数字、研究以及事物心理学的热爱。

sentences.en: And Mantra just felt like the perfect way to do this.
sentences.zh: 而《Mantra》恰好是实现这一点的完美方式。

sentences.en: Every Monday is a mental reset.
sentences.zh: 每周一都是一次心灵的重置。

sentences.en: You tune in on your morning commute, when you're at work, when you're at the gym, and it just sets the tone for the rest of your week.
sentences.zh: 你可以在早晨通勤时、在工作时、在健身时收听，它能为你接下来的一周定下基调。

sentences.en: You can be one of the first people to hear it and listen to the brand new episode if you subscribe to Mantra now on Spotify or Apple Podcasts.
sentences.zh: 如果你现在就在 Spotify 或 Apple Podcasts 上订阅《Mantra》，你就能成为第一批听到并收听全新单集的人。

sentences.en: It's already up there.
sentences.zh: 它已经上线了。

sentences.en: It's ready to go.
sentences.zh: 随时可以收听。

sentences.en: The first episode drops in less than a week.
sentences.zh: 第一集将在不到一周后发布。

sentences.en: I hope you love it.
sentences.zh: 我希望你们会喜欢。

sentences.en: I really, really do.
sentences.zh: 我是真心这么希望的。

sentences.en: It is just such a passion project for me.
sentences.zh: 这对我来说真的是一个充满热忱的项目。

sentences.en: It's something I think is going to be such an important thing to put out into the world, hopefully make a huge difference, hopefully just inspire you,
sentences.zh: 我认为将这样一件重要的事情带给世界，希望能带来巨大的改变，希望能激励到你，

sentences.en: give you more things to listen to.
sentences.zh: 为你提供更多可听的内容。

sentences.en: If you need a new podcast, there it is.
sentences.zh: 如果你需要一档新播客，就是它了。

sentences.en: Without further ado, though, let's talk about the psychology of manifestation, which is, of course, today's topic.
sentences.zh: 不过闲话少说，让我们来聊聊吸引力法则（Manifestation）的心理学，这当然也是今天的主题。

sentences.en: One that I have been really excited to do for a while, actually.
sentences.zh: 其实这个主题我一直很期待做很久了。

sentences.en: It's very much been at the top of the list, but just keeps getting bumped down by things that felt more important.
sentences.zh: 它本来一直在选题清单的前列，但总是被那些感觉更紧急的事情给挤下去了。

sentences.en: But it's a brand new year, and this just felt like a great episode to dive into straight off the bat.
sentences.zh: 但新年新气象，我觉得这就是一个开局直接深入探讨的绝佳节目。

sentences.en: So if you are brand new to manifestation,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你对吸引力法则还很陌生，

sentences.en: I'll give you a quick 101.
sentences.zh: 我会为你做一个简单的入门介绍。

sentences.en: Manifesting is this very affirming, significant idea that you can attract your dream life by using your thoughts.
sentences.zh: 吸引力法则是一种非常肯定、意义重大的理念，即你可以通过自己的思想来吸引你梦想的生活。

sentences.en: How you view a situation matters, and it's a powerful way to bring about your greatest desires.
sentences.zh: 你如何看待一种处境至关重要，这是实现你最大愿望的有力方式。

sentences.en: So basically, if we think positive things, they will happen.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上，如果我们抱持积极的想法，好事就会发生。

sentences.en: If we think we are lucky, lucky things will happen to us.
sentences.zh: 如果我们认为自己很幸运，幸运的事情就会降临到我们头上。

sentences.en: That is the whole premise.
sentences.zh: 这就是全部的前提。

sentences.en: And manifesting, it's become so incredibly popular in recent years, specifically after the success of a book called
sentences.zh: 近年来吸引力法则变得非常流行，特别是在一本书获得成功之后，

sentences.en: The Secret actually was written by an Australian author back in 2006, and it reintroduced this ancient idea that your thoughts are a powerful magnet for the reality that you want.
sentences.zh: 这本书叫《秘密》，实际上是由一位澳大利亚作家在 2006 年写的，它重新引入了这样一个古老的观点：你的思想是你想要的生活的强大磁铁。

sentences.en: That premise has, of course, existed in a number of cultures for thousands of years.
sentences.zh: 当然，这个前提在许多文化中已经存在了数千年之久。

sentences.en: It's important to acknowledge that.
sentences.zh: 这一点很重要，我们必须承认。

sentences.en: Buddha, for example, taught that our thoughts shape us and that our intentions determine our destinies.
sentences.zh: 例如，佛陀曾教导说，我们的思想塑造了我们，我们的意图决定了我们的命运。

sentences.en: So it's definitely not a new idea, but it's a very powerful one that has reached a whole new audience.
sentences.zh: 所以这绝对不是一个新观念，但它是一个非常强大的观念，触及了全新的受众群体。

sentences.en: If it sounds too good to be true, I get you.
sentences.zh: 如果听起来好得令人难以置信，我理解你。

sentences.en: I totally understand.
sentences.zh: 我完全能理解。

sentences.en: Especially if you're someone who is quite scientific like me.
sentences.zh: 特别是如果你像我一样是个相当理性、注重科学的人。

sentences.en: Anything that offers a simple, quick fix, easy solution to transform your life, to make everything possible, to, you know, make a million dollars, sounds like a scam.
sentences.zh: 任何提供简单、快速修复、轻松解决生活问题、让一切皆有可能、比如说“赚到一百万”的捷径，听起来都像是一场骗局。

sentences.en: Additionally, we do really have to talk about how elitist manifestation can sometimes seem for people who are experiencing poverty or starvation or war
sentences.zh: 此外，我们确实不得不谈谈，对于那些正经历贫困、饥饿或战争、

sentences.en: for whom thinking positive things will most likely not change a larger systemic problem.
sentences.zh: 对他们来说仅仅靠积极思考很可能无法改变更大的系统性问题的人而言，吸引力法则有时会显得多么精英主义。

sentences.en: There are some criticisms of manifestation.
sentences.zh: 对吸引力法则确实存在一些批评。

sentences.en: It's definitely got some major issues.
sentences.zh: 它绝对存在一些重大问题。

sentences.en: We're going to talk about that later on, but I also really want to break it down for you and show that it's not just a magical, mystical idea.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后会讨论这一点，但我也真的很想为大家剖析它，表明它不仅仅是一个神奇、神秘的概念。

sentences.en: For the people who successfully implement manifestation, a lot of it is really rooted in psychology and in our cognition and in our subconscious minds
sentences.zh: 对于那些成功实践吸引力法则的人来说，其中很大一部分其实深深植根于心理学、我们的认知、我们的潜意识，

sentences.en: and how our beliefs and our mindset subliminally control our actions and our behaviors.
sentences.zh: 以及我们的信念和心态如何潜移默化地控制我们的行动和行为。

sentences.en: You know, if you really believe something will happen to you and you have the ability and the resources to action that belief, that's crucial.
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果你真的相信某事会发生在你身上，并且你有能力和资源去付诸行动，这至关重要。

sentences.en: It does create a self-fulfilling prophecy where you are more likely to act in a way that ensures that it will, even if you don't realize it.
sentences.zh: 这确实会创造一个自我实现的预言，让你更有可能以确保其发生的方式行事，即使你并没有意识到这一点。

sentences.en: You know, obviously, if you think something will happen and you don't do anything about it, manifesting will never work for you.
sentences.zh: 你知道，很显然，如果你认为某事会发生但却什么都不做，吸引力法则永远不会对你起作用。

sentences.en: If you think, yeah, it would be nice to be rich and then just sit twiddling your thumbs waiting for it to happen, that's not how manifestation works.
sentences.zh: 如果你心想，“嗯，变有钱挺不错的”，然后就坐在那儿转动大拇指干等它发生，吸引力法则可不是这么运作的。

sentences.en: There is some really powerful psychology and neuroscience behind this very legitimate self-help practice that can spur on goal-directed action.
sentences.zh: 在这个非常合法的自助实践背后，确实存在一些非常强大的心理学和神经科学，能够激发以目标为导向的行动。

sentences.en: It really relies on things from cognitive restructuring to the power of self-talk, the power of self-belief and concepts, neurological concepts like long-term potentiation.
sentences.zh: 它真正依赖的因素从认知重构到自我对话的力量、自我信念的力量，以及诸如长期增强作用之类的神经学概念。

sentences.en: So today I want to talk about it if you're on the fence, if you're completely committed to the idea, if you're just trying to level up and improve the way you manifest,
sentences.zh: 所以今天我想探讨的是，无论你还在观望，还是完全笃信这个理念，亦或是你只是想提升并改进你的吸引力法则运用方式，

sentences.en: this episode is for you.
sentences.zh: 这期节目都是为你准备的。

sentences.en: There is so much science, so much fascinating research to cover in this episode.
sentences.zh: 本期节目中有太多的科学知识和迷人的研究等待我们去探讨。

sentences.en: And I also want to provide the five most powerful manifestation exercises that you can use based on all this psychology.
sentences.zh: 我还想根据所有这些心理学原理，提供你可以使用的五种最强大的吸引力法则练习。

sentences.en: So all of that and so much more, it is a jam-packed episode after this short break.
sentences.zh: 所以，所有这些以及更多精彩内容，都在这段简短的广告之后，这是一期干货满满的节目。

sentences.en: Manifestation has definitely been having a moment in the self-help wellness space in recent years.
sentences.zh: 近年来，吸引力法则在自助健康领域确实大行其道。

sentences.en: I don't know when I first really became aware of manifesting as a concept, but when I did, I will admit, I thought it was ridiculous.
sentences.zh: 我记不清自己是什么时候真正意识到吸引力法则这个概念的，但当我意识到时，我必须承认，我觉得这太荒谬了。

sentences.en: You know, how could your thoughts make anything magically happen for you?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你的思想怎么可能凭空让任何事情神奇地为你发生？

sentences.en: You know, I have thousands, millions of thoughts every day.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我每天都有成千上万、数以百万计的想法。

sentences.en: Very few of them ever come true.
sentences.zh: 其中极少数能真正变成现实。

sentences.en: I think that definitely came down to being a bit of an overachiever as well.
sentences.zh: 我想这绝对归咎于我也有点过于追求完美。

sentences.en: You know, I really believed in the absolute power of blood, sweat and tears and hard work.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我真的坚信血汗、泪水和努力工作的绝对力量。

sentences.en: Really, that was my like, that's my equation.
sentences.zh: 真的，那就是我的公式，这就是我的等式。

sentences.en: You work hard, you get what you work for and what you deserve.
sentences.zh: 你努力工作，你就能得到你为之付出和应得的东西。

sentences.en: But in 2019, I really had my first instance of kind of realizing that I had manifested certain things in my life.
sentences.zh: 但在 2019 年，我确实有了第一次顿悟，意识到自己已经在生活中吸引（manifested）了某些事情。

sentences.en: I'd gone through a breakup.
sentences.zh: 我刚经历了一次分手。

sentences.en: I was, you know, really committed to repeating all these positive statements to myself.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我真的致力于对自己重复所有这些积极的陈述。

sentences.en: I was journaling about what I wanted in the next month, three months, year.
sentences.zh: 我在手帐里写下我在接下来的一个月、三个月、一年里想要什么。

sentences.en: And strangely, a lot of it was coming true.
sentences.zh: 奇怪的是，其中很多事情都成真了。

sentences.en: And when I was investigating and I was like, wow, why is this happening?
sentences.zh: 当我在调查研究、心想“哇，为什么会这样”时，

sentences.en: You know, it can't just all be luck.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这不可能全靠运气。

sentences.en: And I think it really came down to how these practices
sentences.zh: 我想这确实归结于这些实践

sentences.en: were restructuring and shifting how my mind thought about probleMs.
sentences.zh: 如何重构和转变了我的思维看待问题的方式。

sentences.en: Okay, I've already gone off on a tangent.
sentences.zh: 好了，我刚才已经扯远了。

sentences.en: Let's dial it back for a second.
sentences.zh: 让我们稍微收回一下思绪。

sentences.en: Let's talk about the pillars of manifestation, the most common manifestation techniques, themes, topics, basically.
sentences.zh: 我们来谈谈吸引力法则的支柱，也就是最常见的吸引力法则技巧、主题，基本上就是这些。

sentences.en: So the biggest form or theory of manifestation is undoubtedly the law of attraction.
sentences.zh: 因此，吸引力法则最大的一形式或理论无疑是吸引力法则（Law of Attraction）。

sentences.en: Law of attraction, you would have heard it everywhere.
sentences.zh: 吸引力法则，你一定到处都听过。

sentences.en: And this law basically suggests that your thoughts and beliefs can attract people, events and circumstances into your life.
sentences.zh: 这一法则基本上表明，你的思想和信念可以吸引人、事件和环境进入你的生活。

sentences.en: and it's very much based on the idea that people and their thoughts are made up of pure energy and like energy, similar energy attracts similar energy, thereby allowing us
sentences.zh: 它在很大程度上基于这样一种理念：人和他们的思想由纯能量组成，同类能量、相似的能量会吸引相似的能量，从而使我们

sentences.en: to improve our health, wealth or personal relationships by thinking positive things and attracting those positive things to us.
sentences.zh: 能够通过思考积极的事物并吸引这些积极的事物来改善我们的健康、财富或人际关系。

sentences.en: So basically, your thoughts are a magnet.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上，你的思想就是一块磁铁。

sentences.en: They attract whatever you think you desire or that you think of and that you focus on.
sentences.zh: 它们会吸引你认为自己渴望的、或者你所想到并专注于的任何东西。

sentences.en: Another very famous form of manifestation is of course the law of detachment.
sentences.zh: 吸引力法则的另一个非常著名的形式当然是疏离法则（Law of Detachment）。

sentences.en: This sounds like the opposite of the law of attraction but it's definitely not an entire contradiction.
sentences.zh: 这听起来像是吸引力法则的对立面，但它绝对不是完全矛盾的。

sentences.en: It basically suggests that in order to manifest our desires we have to release our attachment to a specific outcome.
sentences.zh: 它基本上表明，为了实现我们的愿望，我们必须释放对特定结果的执着。

sentences.en: So if you are trying to manifest love, I know that's a big one, you need to release the idea of what love could look like for you.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你正试图吸引爱情——我知道这是一个重大的愿望——你需要放下对爱情对你而言可能是什么样子的既定想象。

sentences.en: So you cannot keep expecting that love is going to be this six foot four dark haired person who is a lawyer who does these exact specific things and their name is Andrew
sentences.zh: 所以你不能一直期望爱情会是一个身高六尺四、黑头发、是个律师、做着这些特定事情、名字叫安德鲁的人，

sentences.en: and they're 27.
sentences.zh: 而且他 27 岁。

sentences.en: Like you can't imagine a specific kind of person.
sentences.zh: 就像你不能想象一个特定类型的人一样。

sentences.en: You have to detach from your expectations about how whatever your desire will come to you.
sentences.zh: 你必须抽离出对你的愿望将如何降临到你身上的期望。

sentences.en: Like what's the outcome going to be?
sentences.zh: 比如结果会是什么样的？

sentences.en: You have to detach from a specific outcome.
sentences.zh: 你必须从特定的结果中抽离出来。

sentences.en: Same with a, you know, a dream job if you're manifesting your dream career.
sentences.zh: 如果你在吸引你梦想的职业，梦想的工作也是如此。

sentences.en: You have to accept that maybe what you have in mind isn't right and let, let's say the universe or a higher power, that's how a lot of people normally talk about this,
sentences.zh: 你必须接受，也许你心中的想法并不正确，让——我们假设是宇宙或某种高等力量，很多人通常都是这么讨论的——

sentences.en: how you have to let that guide you.
sentences.zh: 让你去顺其自然。

sentences.en: So, why I see this working on a psychological basis is that this perspective creates an internal shift and it puts us into a growth and curiosity mindset so that opportunities
sentences.zh: 所以，我看到这在心理学基础上起作用的原因是，这种视角创造了内部转变，将我们带入了成长和好奇心的心态，从而使我们以前可能没有看过的机会

sentences.en: we may have previously not looked at now become available to us so it keeps us more open.
sentences.zh: 现在对我们开放了，所以它让我们保持更加开放的心态。

sentences.en: I definitely have some issues with the premise behind the law of detachment because I think especially for people who are anxious or who have anxiety or who have OCD
sentences.zh: 对于疏离法则背后的前提，我确实有一些异议，因为我认为特别是对于那些焦虑、患有焦虑症或患有强迫症的人来说，

sentences.en: detaching from an outcome or breaking out of a thought pattern can be extremely hard, near impossible.
sentences.zh: 从一个结果中抽离出来或打破一种思维模式可能是极其困难的，几乎是不可能的。

sentences.en: That doesn't mean that these individuals don't still have dreams that come true.
sentences.zh: 这并不意味着这些人就不会有梦想成真的时候。

sentences.en: so there are certainly some holes in this logic, right?
sentences.zh: 所以这种逻辑确实存在一些漏洞，对吧？

sentences.en: People who are overly anxious don't just have bad things happen to them as well.
sentences.zh: 过于焦虑的人并不意味着只会遭遇不好的事情。

sentences.en: You know, the opposite of law of attraction, you know, if law of attraction is correct, you know, thinking about negative things would make negative things happen to you.
sentences.zh: 你知道，吸引力法则的对立面，你知道，如果吸引力法则正确的话，你知道，思考消极的事情会使消极的事情发生在你身上。

sentences.en: Someone who is overly anxious, that's not always the case.
sentences.zh: 过于焦虑的人，情况并非总是如此。

sentences.en: So, moving back to the law of attraction because I think that is really the manifestation technique that we're zoning in on today.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们回到吸引力法则上来，因为我认为这正是我们今天重点关注的显化技巧。

sentences.en: If you think it's simply about asking the universe to reward you as I once did, I really want to explain further that psychology and that psychological explanation.
sentences.zh: 如果你认为这仅仅是像我曾经做的那样，要求宇宙奖赏你，我真的很想进一步解释背后的心理学及其心理学解释。

sentences.en: And we have to start with this very fundamental logic.
sentences.zh: 而我们必须从这个非常基础的逻辑开始。

sentences.en: Believing that you can accomplish something is going to make it much more likely that you do compared to not believing.
sentences.zh: 相信自己能够完成某事，会比不相信更有可能让你真正做到。

sentences.en: What does this rest on?
sentences.zh: 这建立在什么基础之上？

sentences.en: It rests on the power of self-belief.
sentences.zh: 它建立在自信的力量之上。

sentences.en: Self-belief, that is the number one biggest factor in any success story that you will ever hear.
sentences.zh: 自信，这是你听过的任何成功故事中排名第一的最大因素。

sentences.en: And yet, I think it is the least talked about.
sentences.zh: 然而，我认为这是最少被讨论的。

sentences.en: You cannot be motivated, you cannot be disciplined, you cannot be a risk taker, you cannot bet on yourself if you do not believe that success will be yours.
sentences.zh: 如果你不相信成功会属于你，你就无法被激励，无法自律，无法冒险，也无法把赌注押在自己身上。

sentences.en: So, not believing in yourself is a goal ending contradiction.
sentences.zh: 因此，不相信自己是一个会导致目标破灭的矛盾。

sentences.en: The reason that the law of attraction works and that many people see manifesting as a very golden key that unlocks this incredible life of theirs is because of how it changes our
sentences.zh: 吸引力法则之所以管用，许多人也将显化视为开启他们不可思议人生的黄金钥匙，是因为它改变了我们的

sentences.en: underlying subconscious subliminal thoughts to do with self-belief.
sentences.zh: 与自信相关的潜在潜意识思维。

sentences.en: This is called by another name, it's called cognitive restructuring which we've already mentioned a couple of times.
sentences.zh: 这有另一个名字，叫做认知重构，我们之前已经提到过好几次了。

sentences.en: It's a very well-researched legitimate therapeutic technique.
sentences.zh: 这是一种经过充分研究的、合法的治疗技术。

sentences.en: Basically, what this method has people do is identify negative thoughts or self-limiting thoughts and challenge them, replace them with more positive thoughts.
sentences.zh: 基本上，这个方法让人识别负面想法或自我限制的想法，并挑战它们，用更积极的想法取而代之。

sentences.en: So let me give you an example of how this could be used using the American
sentences.zh: 所以我举个例子，说明如何使用美国

sentences.en: Psychological
sentences.zh: 心理学

sentences.en: Association's accredited five-step process to cognitive restructuring or CBT.
sentences.zh: 协会认证的五步认知重构或CBT（认知行为疗法）流程来做到这一点。

sentences.en: Firstly, a person identifies the situation and feeling that they would like to change.
sentences.zh: 首先，一个人要确定他们想要改变的情境和感受。

sentences.en: For example, let's say anxiety about the future, it's one I always use for people in their 20s.
sentences.zh: 例如，比方说对未来的焦虑，这是我经常对20多岁的人使用的一个例子。

sentences.en: Then you identify the underlying thoughts about the feeling.
sentences.zh: 然后，你找出这种感受背后的潜在想法。

sentences.en: So for example, why am I feeling anxious about the future?
sentences.zh: 比如，为什么我对未来感到焦虑？

sentences.en: Well, probably because
sentences.zh: 嗯，可能是因为

sentences.en: I'm uncertain,
sentences.zh: 我感到不确定，

sentences.en: I'm scared of failure, I expect the worst-case scenario to happen.
sentences.zh: 我害怕失败，我预料最坏的情况会发生。

sentences.en: And then it asks people to look for evidence of that being the case in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 然后它要求人们在过去寻找这种情境存在的证据。

sentences.en: So what is your worst-case scenario here?
sentences.zh: 所以你这里最坏的情况是什么？

sentences.en: I'm going to fail,
sentences.zh: 我会失败，

sentences.en: I'm going to be miserable,
sentences.zh: 我会很痛苦，

sentences.en: I'm never going to find success.
sentences.zh: 我永远不会成功。

sentences.en: I say, what's the evidence for that being the case?
sentences.zh: 我说，那有证据表明会这样吗？

sentences.en: Who's telling you this?
sentences.zh: 谁跟你这么说的？

sentences.en: Where's the magic ball?
sentences.zh: 水晶球在哪里？

sentences.en: And then it gets you to really focus on the alternative.
sentences.zh: 然后它让你真正专注于替代方案。

sentences.en: What if the worst-case scenario didn't happen?
sentences.zh: 如果最坏的情况没有发生呢？

sentences.en: What if you were a success?
sentences.zh: 如果你成功了呢？

sentences.en: Why couldn't that happen to you?
sentences.zh: 为什么这种事不会发生在你身上？

sentences.en: What if it all worked out for you?
sentences.zh: 如果一切都对你有利呢？

sentences.en: Then they ask you to make a decision.
sentences.zh: 然后他们要求你做一个决定。

sentences.en: And when a future dilemma like this one comes up, do you continue to choose the more helpful thought or do you continue to choose the less helpful thought?
sentences.zh: 当未来出现这样的困境时，你是继续选择更有帮助的想法，还是继续选择帮助不大的想法？

sentences.en: This really changes how our brain responds to a problem by changing our thought circuits and pathways that are attached to it.
sentences.zh: 这通过改变与其相连的思维回路和途径，真正改变了我们的大脑对问题的反应方式。

sentences.en: Cognitive restructuring sounds a lot like manifestation in that way.
sentences.zh: 从这个角度来看，认知重构听起来很像显化。

sentences.en: Manifestation is working to create more positive thoughts for a positive outcome and really, you know, what that entails is introducing positive scenarios into your mind.
sentences.zh: 显化致力于创造更多积极的想法以获得积极的结果，实际上，你知道，这需要在你的大脑中引入积极的情境。

sentences.en: Cognitive restructuring kind of sounds the same.
sentences.zh: 认知重构听起来也有点像。

sentences.en: There is a lot of evidence for this kind of technique working.
sentences.zh: 有很多证据表明这种技术是有效的。

sentences.en: So there was a
sentences.zh: 所以曾有一项

sentences.en: 2020 study that looked at 141 individuals who received cognitive restructuring treatment and it found that at a
sentences.zh: 2020年的研究，调查了141名接受认知重构治疗的个体，发现在

sentences.en: 12-month follow-up, individuals reported lower depressive symptoms, less anxious avoidance, and this is the really big one, greater self-efficacy.
sentences.zh: 12个月的随访中，个人报告了较低的抑郁症状、较少的焦虑回避，而这才是真正重大的一点，那就是更高的自我效能感。

sentences.en: So self-efficacy, we talk about it a lot, it's probably one of my favorite concepts and it basically says that our ability, our belief and our ability to achieve an outcome that
sentences.zh: 所以自我效能感，我们经常讨论它，它可能是我最喜欢的概念之一，它基本上说明了我们的能力，我们对自己能够实现

sentences.en: we want is really, really important.
sentences.zh: 我们想要的结果的信念，是非常非常重要的。

sentences.en: So self-efficacy is basically your self-belief in bringing about your future or being able to work hard or be consistent.
sentences.zh: 因此，自我效能感基本上就是你对自己创造未来、能够努力工作或保持连贯性的自信。

sentences.en: So, you know, if you have a big project at work or you want to launch a business, people who are high in self-efficacy will say, yeah,
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，如果你在工作中有个大项目或者想创业，自我效能感高的人会说，是的，

sentences.en: I'm capable of that, it's going to be hard but I'm ready for the challenge, I can do it.
sentences.zh: 我有这个能力，这会很难，但我已经准备好迎接挑战了，我能做到。

sentences.en: Whereas if you're low in self-efficacy, you'll doubt yourself into an inaction, basically.
sentences.zh: 而如果你自我效能感低，基本上你就会自我怀疑到无所作为。

sentences.en: Luckily, self-efficacy is something that you can change and this is one way of doing it, that cognitive restructuring.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，自我效能感是你可以改变的，而认知重构就是做到这一点的方法之一。

sentences.en: Another explanation for the psychology of manifestation is what we know very commonly as a self-fulfilling prophecy.
sentences.zh: 对显化心理学的另一种解释是我们俗称的“自证预言”。

sentences.en: So a self-fulfilling prophecy occurs when our beliefs and expectations influence our actions in ways that bring those beliefs to life.
sentences.zh: 因此，当我们的信念和期望以使这些信念变为现实的方式影响我们的行动时，自证预言就发生了。

sentences.en: So in the context of manifestation, by visualizing success or a desired outcome, we subconsciously align our decisions, attitudes and actions with that goal.
sentences.zh: 所以在显化的语境下，通过想象成功或期望的结果，我们在潜意识里将我们的决定、态度和行动与该目标保持一致。

sentences.en: This focus really increases our motivation, our perseverance and our openness to those opportunities we might previously overlook.
sentences.zh: 这种专注真正增强了我们的动力、毅力以及对那些我们以前可能忽视的机会的开放心态。

sentences.en: So in essence, manifestation leverages the psychological mechanism of a self-fulfilling prophecy by turning positive beliefs into deliberate action, really bridging the
sentences.zh: 因此，本质上，显化通过将积极的信念转化为刻意的行动，利用了自证预言的心理机制，真正架起了

sentences.en: gap between intention and achievement.
sentences.zh: 意图与成就之间的桥梁。

sentences.en: So if you walk into a room thinking everyone in this room is going to fall in love with you, is going to think that you are charismatic and attractive and alluring, you are
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你走进一个房间，认为这个房间里的每个人都会爱上你，会认为你很有魅力、有吸引力、迷人，你

sentences.en: going to feel better about yourself.
sentences.zh: 就会对自我感觉更好。

sentences.en: And so because of that, you'll probably speak to more people, you'll be more open, you'll make more eye contact, you'll feel better, and you might walk out and say, oh
sentences.zh: 正因如此，你可能会和更多的人说话，你会更加开放，会有更多的眼神交流，你会感觉更好，然后你可能会走出去说，哦，

sentences.en: my god, I manifested that.
sentences.zh: 我的天哪，这是我显化出来的。

sentences.en: That is really actually a self-fulfilling prophecy.
sentences.zh: 这实际上真的就是一个自证预言。

sentences.en: And if you want to see it in action, you've got to hear about this very famous experiment from the 1960s.
sentences.zh: 如果你想看它的实际效果，你必须了解20世纪60年代这个非常著名的实验。

sentences.en: You've probably heard about it before, but it was about how teachers expectations of students actually determined their grades and the students who performed beSt.
sentences.zh: 你以前可能听说过，但它是关于老师对学生的期望如何真正决定了他们的成绩以及表现最好的学生。

sentences.en: And it really came down to the students who wore glasses.
sentences.zh: 而这实际上归结为那些戴眼镜的学生。

sentences.en: Because the teachers assumed, you know, if you wear glasses, you're more intelligent.
sentences.zh: 因为老师们认为，你知道，如果你戴眼镜，你就会更聪明。

sentences.en: So they treated them as such.
sentences.zh: 所以他们就这样对待他们。

sentences.en: They treated them as if they were already intelligent.
sentences.zh: 他们把他们当作已经很聪明的人来对待。

sentences.en: And therefore, it created that self-fulfilling prophecy.
sentences.zh: 因此，这就创造了那个自证预言。

sentences.en: It meant that they gave them more attention.
sentences.zh: 这意味着他们给予了他们更多的关注。

sentences.en: It meant that they gave them more praise.
sentences.zh: 这意味着他们给予了他们更多的表扬。

sentences.en: It meant that they spent more time with them.
sentences.zh: 这意味着他们花更多的时间陪他们。

sentences.en: It gave them more challenging work.
sentences.zh: 这给了他们更具挑战性的工作。

sentences.en: And so they were the ones who achieved.
sentences.zh: 所以他们才是取得成就的人。

sentences.en: All because of a self-fulfilling prophecy.
sentences.zh: 这一切都归功于自证预言。

sentences.en: And you can use that same formula on yourself.
sentences.zh: 你也可以把同样的公式用在自己身上。

sentences.en: So two final points on the psychology of manifestation.
sentences.zh: 关于显化心理学的最后两点。

sentences.en: The other reason that we tend to think that what we think about attracts what we experience also comes down to how the thought patterns that occur with manifestation unlock
sentences.zh: 我们倾向于认为我们所想的会吸引我们所经历的，另一个原因也归结为显化伴随的思维模式如何开启了

sentences.en: a growth versus a fixed mindset.
sentences.zh: 成长型与固定型思维模式。

sentences.en: So a fixed mindset assumes that our abilities are innate and unchangeable.
sentences.zh: 因此，固定型思维模式假设我们的能力是天生且不可改变的。

sentences.en: That what we're born with is what we're given.
sentences.zh: 我们生来是什么样就是什么样。

sentences.en: If we're lazy we're lazy.
sentences.zh: 如果我们懒惰，我们就是懒惰。

sentences.en: If we're not good at sports we're not good at sports.
sentences.zh: 如果我们不擅长运动，我们就是不擅长运动。

sentences.en: If we're not disciplined we're not disciplined.
sentences.zh: 如果我们缺乏纪律，我们就是缺乏纪律。

sentences.en: A growth mindset means that we believe that all humans you and I are capable of change and that we can improve.
sentences.zh: 成长型思维模式意味着我们相信所有人类——你和我——都有改变的能力，并且我们可以不断进步。

sentences.en: And that means that our beliefs about our ability to learn, grow and succeed our growth mindset can indeed affect whether we effectively manifest what we desire.
sentences.zh: 这意味着我们关于学习、成长和成功能力的信念——我们的成长型思维模式——确实会影响我们是否能有效地显化我们所渴望的事物。

sentences.en: Importantly the research really suggests that if we truly believe we can achieve something we are more willing to do the hard work to achieve it.
sentences.zh: 重要的是，研究确实表明，如果我们坚信自己能实现某事，我们就更愿意付出艰苦的努力去实现它。

sentences.en: So manifesting by saying all those positive statements to yourself by saying this is what I really want.
sentences.zh: 因此，通过对你自己说所有这些积极的陈述来显化，通过说这就是我真正想要的。

sentences.en: This is who I am.
sentences.zh: 这就是我。

sentences.en: This is what I'm going to achieve.
sentences.zh: 这就是我要实现的。

sentences.en: It means that the parts of ourselves that are willing to work for that are more activated that we're more willing to grow into a challenge.
sentences.zh: 这意味着我们体内愿意为此努力的部分被更多地激活了，我们更愿意迎难而上。

sentences.en: And finally the reason that manifestation works is what we call the upward spiral of positive emotions.
sentences.zh: 最后，显化之所以起作用，是因为我们所谓的“积极情绪的向上螺旋”。

sentences.en: So the thought process behind manifestation actually incidentally also creates an important cognitive positive feedback loop where the more we think positive good things
sentences.zh: 因此，显化背后的思维过程实际上也顺便创造了一个重要的认知积极反馈循环，即我们越多地思考积极美好的事物，

sentences.en: the more we actually tend to see positive good things like a confirmation bias.
sentences.zh: 我们就越倾向于看到积极美好的事物，就像确认偏误一样。

sentences.en: And then it goes a step further which means that we actually are generally more optimistic, motivated, happy about our current state because all these good things are happening
sentences.zh: 然后它又向前迈进了一步，这意味着由于所有这些美好的事情正在发生

sentences.en: to us.
sentences.zh: 在我们身上，我们总体上实际上变得更加乐观、有动力、对现状感到快乐。

sentences.en: We can see all these good things around us because we've been
sentences.zh: 我们能看到周围所有这些美好的事物，因为我们已经被

sentences.en: cued to see those things, primed to see those things.
sentences.zh: 暗示去看到这些事物，被唤起去看到这些事物。

sentences.en: And of course someone who is more happy optimistic is going to be more motivated.
sentences.zh: 当然，一个更快乐乐观的人会更有动力。

sentences.en: So manifestation techniques like the law of attraction or the law of detachment they really seemingly work because of how they transform the perception of our circumstances, our
sentences.zh: 因此，像吸引力法则或疏离法则这样的显化技巧，之所以看似奏效，是因为它们改变了我们对自身处境的感知、我们的

sentences.en: self-beliefs and therefore trigger important goal intentional and activating behaviors.
sentences.zh: 自信，从而触发了重要的以目标为导向和激活的行为。

sentences.en: I want to be really really clear there is zero proof that manifestation works on its own.
sentences.zh: 我想非常非常明确地指出，没有任何证据表明显化本身就能起作用。

sentences.en: Some people do like to cite this idea of quantum theory which states that everything in the universe is made up of energy.
sentences.zh: 有些人确实喜欢引用量子理论的观点，该理论指出宇宙中的一切都是由能量组成的。
